title: Return policy
body: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Shipping times
body: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days. You will get a tracking link by email once your order ships.

title: Refund approval
body: Refunds up to 100 are approved automatically for delivered orders. Larger refunds are reviewed by a team member.
